findings.book_entry: An earthly kingdom, city, state, or governed political body riding upon the sea of peoples: its rulers guide it, its inhabitants and servants crew it, its armies defend it, and its wealth is carried as cargo. Christ needs no constructed body beneath Him: He walks upon the sea directly, and when He sails with His disciples the vessel comes under its true Head. The ship may be broken while its people survive.

openai.adjudicated_core_identification: A ship, when functioning symbolically, represents an organized earthly governed body such as a city, state, kingdom, or polity.

anthropic.adjudicated_core_identification: A ship symbolizes an earthly kingdom, city, state, or governed political body riding upon the sea of peoples: its pilots are its rulers, its crew its inhabitants and servants, its defenders its armies, its cargo its wealth; the vessel may be broken while its people survive.

xai.adjudicated_core_identification: An earthly kingdom, city, state, or governed political body riding upon the sea of peoples, with rulers as pilots, inhabitants/servants as crew, armies as defenders, and wealth as cargo.
